title: Hazel and the Confession
author: Isandro Almeida
blurb: Quentin Galloway, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
